entries.title: HTML Cache maintenance cache page.
entries.notes: Authentic route target. Requires an authenticated admin with the maintenance-manage permission, one seeded site/domain, and migrated HTML Cache tables so the real site row is rendered.
entries.useCase: An administrator clears, warms, or regenerates cached HTML for a site.

entries.title: Cached model URLs resource index.
entries.notes: Deferred authentic route target. Requires an authenticated admin with HTML Cache view permission, migrated cache tables, one seeded published Page URL, and at least one recorded CachedModelUrl row.
entries.useCase: An administrator reviews model-to-URL cache map rows after a public page has been warmed.

entries.title: HTML Cache dashboard widgets.
entries.notes: Deferred authentic route target. Requires an authenticated admin with the dashboard cache widgets enabled, migrated HTML Cache tables, and seeded PageUrl, CachedModelUrl, and StaleCachedUrl rows so the widgets show real state.
entries.useCase: An administrator checks cache overview, coverage, and stale queue widgets.

entries.title: HTML Cache site health cache map.
entries.notes: Deferred authentic route target. Requires an authenticated admin, one seeded site/domain, and cache-map dependency rows so the HTML Cache Site Health widget renders on the real diagnostics page.
entries.useCase: An operator reviews cache-map diagnostics and public-output safety checks in Site Health.

entries.title: Page table cache indicator.
entries.notes: Deferred authentic route target. Requires an authenticated admin, one seeded Page with a published URL, and HTML Cache state recorded for that page so the package table extension renders its real indicator.
entries.useCase: An editor sees cache state indicators directly in the core Pages resource.

entries.title: Anonymous public cache hit.
entries.notes: Deferred authentic route target. Requires an anonymous capture of the seeded public root page after the supported HTML Cache pipeline has warmed it; verify the response is a cache HIT with no authoring surface or session cookie.
entries.useCase: An anonymous visitor receives cached public HTML with no authoring markers, editor URLs, or session cookies.

entries.title: Static maintenance page output.
entries.notes: Deferred authentic route target. Requires an anonymous capture of the seeded public root page while the supported HTML Cache maintenance manifest is active and its static output has been generated for the site/domain.
entries.useCase: An anonymous visitor sees the generated static maintenance page for a site/domain.

entries.title: HTML Cache maintenance cache page with admin sidebar menu open.
entries.notes: Deferred authentic route target. Requires an authenticated admin with the maintenance-manage permission, one seeded site/domain, and migrated HTML Cache tables. Capture this same real Maintenance Cache page with the fully collapsible sidebar opened.
entries.useCase: An administrator clears, warms, or regenerates cached HTML for a site.
